title: 💰 NSO First Advance GDP Estimates FY26 (7.4%) & ₹17 Lakh Crore 3-Year PPP Pipeline
summary: Department of Economic Affairs (MoF) created a 3-year Public Private Partnership (PPP) pipeline comprising 852 projects across Central Infrastructure Ministries, States, and UTs with a combined project cost exceeding ₹17 lakh crore, fulfilling Budget 2025-26 announcement.

blocks.content: **Overview**: Department of Economic Affairs (MoF) created a 3-year Public Private Partnership (PPP) pipeline comprising 852 projects across Central Infrastructure Ministries, States, and UTs with a combined project cost exceeding ₹17 lakh crore, fulfilling Budget 2025-26 announcement.

items: **DEA Creates Three-Year PPP Project Pipeline Worth ₹17 Lakh Crore** (Page 2): Department of Economic Affairs (MoF) created a 3-year Public Private Partnership (PPP) pipeline comprising 852 projects across Central Infrastructure Ministries, States, and UTs with a combined project cost exceeding ₹17 lakh crore, fulfilling Budget 2025-26 announcement.

**NSO Releases First Advance Estimates of GDP for FY 2025-26 at 7.4%** (Page 2): National Statistics Office (MoSPI) released First Advance Estimates of GDP for FY 2025-26 at Constant (2011-12) and Current Prices. Real GDP growth estimated at 7.4% in FY 2025-26 compared to 6.5% in FY 2024-25.

**UN UNDESA Projects India GDP Growth at 6.6% in FY27 and 6.8% in FY28** (Page 3): United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs projected India GDP growth at 7.4% for CY2025, 6.6% in FY 2026-27, and 6.8% in FY 2027-28. Global headline inflation projected to decline to 3.1% in 2026 from 3.4% in 2025.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Sovereign Macroeconomic Growth & Infrastructure Investment. Official NSO FY26 GDP growth estimate (7.4%), DEA 3-year ₹17L Cr PPP pipeline (852 projects), and IMF/WB/UN growth forecasts.
